verses.text: The wicked run away even when no one is chasing them, but good people are as brave as a lion.
When a country rebels, it has many rulers, but a ruler with understanding and knowledge keeps order.
A poor person who crushes the poor is like a heavy rain that washes away all the crops.
Those who turn away from the law praise the wicked, but those who keep the law fight against them.
Evil people do not understand justice, but those who look to the LORD understand it completely.
It is better to be poor and live honestly than to be rich and crooked.
A son who keeps the law is wise, but a son who spends time with people who eat and drink too much shames his father.
Whoever gets rich by charging high interest is collecting it for someone who will be kind to the poor.
If someone refuses to listen to the law, even their prayers are hated by God.
Whoever leads honest people down an evil path will fall into their own trap, but blameless people will receive good things.
Rich people think they are wise, but a poor person with understanding can see through them.
When good people win, there is great celebration, but when the wicked rise to power, people hide.
Whoever hides their sins will not do well, but whoever admits them and turns away from them will find mercy.
Happy is the person who always respects God, but whoever makes their heart hard will fall into trouble.
A wicked ruler over helpless people is like a roaring lion or a charging bear.
A ruler who crushes his people has no sense, but one who hates dishonest gain will live a long life.
Someone who is troubled by the guilt of murder will run until they die. No one should help them.
Whoever lives a blameless life will be kept safe, but whoever follows crooked ways will suddenly fall.
Whoever works their land will have plenty of food, but whoever chases dreams will have plenty of poverty.
A faithful person will be richly blessed, but someone in a hurry to get rich will not go unpunished.
It is not good to take sides, but some people will do wrong for a piece of bread.
A stingy person is in a hurry to get rich and does not know that poverty is waiting for him.
Whoever corrects someone will in the end be more appreciated than someone who flatters.
Whoever robs their father or mother and says, "That's not wrong," is no better than a destroyer.
A greedy person stirs up fights, but whoever trusts in the LORD will do well.
Whoever trusts in themselves is a fool, but whoever lives wisely will be kept safe.
Whoever gives to the poor will never be in need, but whoever closes their eyes to the poor will receive many curses.
When the wicked rise to power, people hide, but when the wicked are destroyed, good people grow in number.
